topography.project_purpose: DEX Aggregator. Structurally: 126 project-authored contract(s) across 10 chain(s); 15 ERC20 tokens, 2 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 9 functional families. Its contracts share 60 common project-authored base contract(s) (protocolfees, nodelegatecall, erc6909claims). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
